output.reason: [ev-2a9b9b849526] says existing services 'without a protocol set' are kept as they are, and must be deleted and recreated 'in order for their protocol to be taken into account by the agent'. That means these services do have a protocol that the pre-1.17 agent never stored. The phrase describes the agent's existing service state, not a Kubernetes Service whose spec.ports[].protocol field is unset. So the proposed Service-field leaf misreads the text: it would flag manifests that leave the field out and miss every other service that existed before the upgrade. Exposure is any upgrade from <1.17.0 with the feature left on (the default). Turning off --bpf-lb-proto-diff, the only control the evidence names, is the shielded overlap.

correction.statement: Exposed: environments upgrading to 1.17.0 from a version below 1.17.0 with services protocol differentiation on (the default). Their existing services keep no protocol until deleted and recreated. Environments that set --bpf-lb-proto-diff=false are shielded.
